Original pull request: https://github.com/cucumber/cucumber-jvm/pull/3162

- Stop using deprecated code

data.content:
Implemented the JUnit 6 upgrade for production code.

Updated all remaining module POMs from `junit-jupiter.version` **5.14.2** to **6.0.2**, and replaced deprecated JUnit Platform resource APIs in the JUnit platform engine with `org.junit.platform.commons.io.Resource` / `ResourceFilter`.

Also fixed a production NullAway warning in `FeatureParserWithIssueReporting` by ensuring the reported discovery issue message is non-null.

`mvn -q -DskipTests compile` now passes. The affected module test run is still blocked by deprecated API usage in existing test sources (`CucumberTestEngineTest`), which I did not modify per the “do not modify test files” constraint.
